prompt: Does a heavier ball fall faster than a light one?
title: Two Balls Dropped Together
question: Both balls are the same size, but ball B is ten times heavier. Dropped together, which lands first?
code:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<!-- hand-made fixture: falling -- Two balls of equal size and different mass dropped together, with an air-resistance knob. Not model output. -->
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>html,body{margin:0;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#f8fafc}canvas{display:block;width:100vw;height:100vh}</style></head>
<body><canvas id="c"></canvas><script>
const cv=document.getElementById('c'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d');let W=0,H=0;
function resize(){const d=devicePixelRatio||1;W=innerWidth;H=innerHeight;cv.width=W*d;cv.height=H*d;ctx.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);}
addEventListener('resize',resize);resize();
const g=9.81,area=0.05,cd=0.47,rho=1.2;let p,balls,t;
function ball(mass,color,name){return{mass,color,name,y:0,v:0,landed:null};}
window.SIM={
  title:'Two Balls Dropped Together',
  params:[
    {id:'massA',label:'Ball A mass (kg)',min:0.1,max:10,step:0.1,value:0.5},
    {id:'massB',label:'Ball B mass (kg)',min:0.1,max:10,step:0.1,value:5},
    {id:'air',label:'Air resistance (0 = vacuum)',min:0,max:3,step:0.1,value:1},
    {id:'height',label:'Drop height (m)',min:5,max:100,step:5,value:40}],
  question:'Both balls are the same size, but ball B is ten times heavier. Dropped together, which lands first?',
  reset(v){p=v;t=0;balls=[ball(p.massA,'#2563eb','A'),ball(p.massB,'#dc2626','B')];}
};
function step(b,h){if(b.landed!==null)return;const k=0.5*rho*cd*area*p.air;
  b.v+=(g-(k/b.mass)*b.v*Math.abs(b.v))*h;b.y+=b.v*h;
  if(b.y>=p.height){b.y=p.height;b.landed=t;}}
function draw(){ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);const top=H*0.1,bottom=H*0.78,s=(bottom-top)/p.height;
  ctx.strokeStyle='#0f172a';ctx.lineWidth=4;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(W*0.15,bottom+22);ctx.lineTo(W*0.85,bottom+22);ctx.stroke();
  balls.forEach((b,i)=>{const x=W*(i?0.65:0.35),y=top+b.y*s;
    ctx.fillStyle=b.color;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,22,0,7);ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#0f172a';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.font='bold 26px system-ui';ctx.fillText(b.name+': '+b.mass+' kg',x,H-80);
    ctx.font='22px system-ui';
    ctx.fillText(b.landed!==null?'Landed at '+b.landed.toFixed(2)+' s':'Speed '+b.v.toFixed(1)+' m/s',x,H-44);});
  ctx.font='22px system-ui';ctx.textAlign='left';ctx.fillText('Time: '+t.toFixed(2)+' s',24,40);}
let last=performance.now();
function frame(now){const dt=Math.min((now-last)/1000,1/30);last=now;const n=8,h=dt/n;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){if(balls.some(b=>b.landed===null))t+=h;balls.forEach(b=>step(b,h));}draw();requestAnimationFrame(frame);}
SIM.reset(Object.fromEntries(SIM.params.map(q=>[q.id,q.value])));requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script></body></html>
